purpose: Independent-deposit replication and a genuinely unseen contiguous spatial sector.

source_selection.candidate_rule: Select the most complete native Sijiaying drillhole database by schema, row counts, coordinate validity and source lineage; do not use grade values or predictive metrics.
source_selection.duplicate_rule: Hash-identical files and boundary-scenario derivatives are not independent deposits.
prohibited_sources: block models created from the candidate target values
grade-threshold boundary optimisation outputs used as predictors

blind_partition.physical_group_rule: Collars within 5 m are one physical-hole group.
blind_partition.axis_rule: Project collar coordinates onto the first principal horizontal axis.
blind_partition.block_rule: Create five contiguous blocks by cumulative assay-support count after target fields remain hidden.
blind_partition.target_opening_rule: Open blind target values exactly once after the source, row linkage, feature contract, code hash and development decision have been frozen.

prediction_contracts.entity_eligibility: The entity must pre-date blind evaluation, have mine coordinates and authoritative lineage, and must not be reconstructed from blind TFe/FeO or model predictions.

learner.hyperparameter_policy: Fixed before blind target values are read.

cross_deposit_evaluation.replication: Fit the frozen common contract on Sijiaying development blocks and evaluate once on its blind block.
cross_deposit_evaluation.zero_shot_transfer: If units, assay support and target definition are harmonised, also train on Qidashan and predict Sijiaying without target-based retuning.
cross_deposit_evaluation.claim_rule: A Qidashan-only entity increment is not called externally validated unless a homologous eligible entity is available at Sijiaying.

stopping_rules.if_no_eligible_authoritative_entity: Run E0 replication only and label entity route unavailable.
stopping_rules.if_development_delta_r2_below_0_1: Do not use entity contract in the blind block.
stopping_rules.after_blind_opening: No model switching or parameter changes.
